title: Dhruva Interactive: Bharat ka pehla game studio, ab Rockstar ka hissa
script: 1997 Bengaluru one-person startup, old desktop computer with dial-up modem, bank loan cheque and coins, calendar 1997, first game contract paper that never released with cross, art for big games: car racing, sci-fi helmet soldier, pirate ship shown as generic icons, team grows to 300 people tokens, acquisition handshake briefcase with dollar 7.9 million, studio building merges, comment question
